ns2:course.label: Introduction to Mechatronics
ns2:course.description: (G E 330) Introduction to the concept and practice of mechatronics. Topics include computer interfacing of physical devices (sensors, actuators), data acquisition, real time programming and real time control, human-machine interfaces, design principles of mechatronics in manufacturing systems and in consumer systems. Same as MFGE 430. Prerequisite: CS 101 or equivalent; GE 320 or equivalent; or consent of instructor.
